afflīgō

afflīgō (adflīgō), afflīgere, afflīxī, afflīctum

verb, third conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

cast down, dishearten

In this lexicon

  • depress

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Tusc. 4.34: animōs adflīgere et dēbilitāre metū (Lewis & Short)
